messages:
nate: heads-up: saw a customer report where the console preview pane showed another org's recent run count for a specific model route. not great.
jess: ugh. steps to repro?
li: i can repro on staging with the demo tenant switching flow. looks like the run-count badge is coming from the global cache key.
cory: is this the same cache we use for per-route telemetry that we shard by route only?
li: yep. code snippet from the edge cache lookup: ```const key = `route:${routeId}:counts`; // missing org context```
jess: ohhh. so we dropped tenant/ org id when we migrated to the fast key format.
nate: timeline: change landed in fast-cache-migration last week, rolled to all regions yesterday. small % canary then global.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-042 (console preview showing cross-org metrics). severity P2.
li: quick mitigation: we can add a prefix with workspaceId in the cache key. patch is tiny but will increase cardinality.
cory: perf hit concern — the cache was intentionally route-only to keep hit rate high. adding workspaceId will fragment cache and increase backend load.
jess: for a fast stopgap can we scope the UI to only use the fresh query (bypass cache) when the preview pane is opened by a tenant switch? fewer users will hit that path.
ate: agree. can we ship bypass-as-canary while we debate long-term?
li: i pushed a flag branch: `preview-cache-bypass` -> https://git.local/r/redwood/console/+/branches/preview-cache-bypass (WIP).
deploy-bot: deploy started: console-preview/preview-cache-bypass -> staging (build #3412)
jess: if we bypass, telemetry and quota attribution still needs to be correct — currently some metrics are tagged by `x-route` only. we need `x-tenant` header in telemetry pipeline too.
cory: where is header stripped? looks like the front proxy injects `x-tenant` but our prefetch CDN drops it for cached items.
li: config snippet from CDN: ```cache_key_headers: [ "x-route", "authorization" ] // x-tenant omitted```
jess: so two bugs: CDN key missing tenant header AND server cache keys missing tenant.
nate: proposal: 1) immediate: enable preview-cache-bypass canary to stop visible leakage 2) short-term: add tenant to server cache keys + add x-tenant to CDN cache key headers 3) longer-term: evaluate tiered caching (tenant-hot vs global) to avoid fragmentation.
cory: +1. need to measure estimated RPS and miss-rate if we add tenant to key. I'll run a sim with last 7d traffic.
li: i've got logs showing some customer saw quota deduction on the wrong org during the same window. example log: ```[2026-03-19T22:14:03Z] INFO route=chat-completions route_id=rc-12 cache_key=route:rc-12:counts served_for=workspace:ws-999 user=alice quota_used=15``` you can see cache_key missing ws. that led to a stale value applied to ws-123 later.
jess: that explains the billing/ quota alarm. we should notify billing for possible adjustments.
nate: i'll loop in support/billing once we have scope. for now let's prevent more leakage.
li: deploy-bot: staged bypass deployed to staging. request for prod: need an approver.
ate: @jess please approve canary bypass for prod. small risk.
jess: approved, but only 10% canary and add an automatic rollback if error rate or latency > 2x baseline.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: console-preview/preview-cache-bypass -> prod (canary 10%).
sre-bot: watch configured: rollback on 2x p95 latency or 5xx rate > 0.5%.
cory: running sim now, estimate cache miss goes from 52% -> 81% for preview path if we add tenant to key. will need 2x backend capacity.
li: that's why i like the tiered cache idea: tenant-hot retains compact key; global falls back. longer-term design doc incoming.
jess: can we also add a telemetry regression test in CI that asserts metrics have `tenant_id` tag populated for preview endpoints?
li: yep, adding e2e check now.
nate: thanks team. i'll draft a short customer comms template for billing/support. also we'll add a rollout UX note to console so admins see when data is live vs prefetched cached.
jess: small thing: update run-card copy to say "counts may be delayed" during canary :grimacing:
li: PR: https://git.local/r/redwood/console/pulls/468 (adds tenant to cache key behind flag)
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: console-preview/preview-cache-bypass -> prod (canary 10%)
sre-bot: monitor: no errors elevated after 12m.
nate: closing loop: we'll keep canary for 4hrs, then decide next steps (patch or tiered design). thanks all :thumbsup:
